title: Maco-RL: Scaling Agent Capabilities with Mixed-Task Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.34703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixed-task reinforcement learning (MixRL) directly trains a unified policy across domains to continually expand agent capabilities without training separate specialists or requiring an extra distillation stage. Despite its appeal, scaling MixRL poses significant challenges in achieving stable and efficient mixed-task learning, effectively allocating rollout compute, and supporting continual domain expansion. To address these challenges, we propose Maco-RL, an approach that effectively scales MixRL. Specifically, Maco-RL employs a quota-based scheduler for asynchronous rollouts across multiple task domains, thereby stabilizing training by balancing gradient contributions and mitigating off-policy effects. Along an orthogonal axis, Maco-RL further introduces Tri-Buffer Sampling (TBS) to allocate compute among samples with varying levels of mastery, promoting sustained frontier exploration while preserving acquired capabilities. translated_title: Maco-RL：通过混合任务强化学习扩展智能体能力
translated_abstract: 混合任务强化学习直接在多个领域上训练统一策略，从而持续扩展智能体能力，无需训练独立的专家模型，也不需要额外的蒸馏阶段。尽管其颇具吸引力，但扩展MixRL在实现稳定高效的混合任务学习、有效分配采样计算资源以及支持持续的领域扩展方面面临重大挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Maco-RL，一种能够有效扩展MixRL的方法。具体而言，Maco-RL采用基于配额的调度器在多个任务领域之间进行异步采样，通过平衡梯度贡献并缓解离策略效应来稳定训练。在另一个正交维度上，Maco-RL进一步引入了三缓冲区采样，在不同掌握程度的样本之间分配计算资源，在保持已获得能力的同时促进持续的前沿探索。实验……（原文截断）
tldr: Maco-RL通过基于配额的异步调度器和三缓冲区采样机制有效扩展混合任务强化学习，实现了智能体能力的稳定训练、高效计算分配与持续的领域扩展。
en_tdlr: Maco-RL effectively scales mixed-task reinforcement learning via a quota-based asynchronous scheduler and Tri-Buffer Sampling, enabling stable training, efficient compute allocation, and continual domain expansion for agent capabilities.
